archetypes.name: driver-action-sync
archetypes.rationale: The plan adds a 4-name allowlist (emit_plan, tally, finalize, validate_plan_commands) to design-log-publish.sh but does not verify these names against the actual design-driver.sh source; if normalize_step or the accepted-action list differs, the fix is incomplete or wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the four action names the plan proposes to allowlist in design-log-publish.sh (emit_plan, tally, finalize, validate_plan_commands) exactly match every sentinel basename that skills/design/scripts/design-driver.sh writes under .completed/ in the current tree. Read design-driver.sh to confirm (a) the normalize_step or equivalent lowercasing logic and (b) every accepted-action value it can produce under any code path. If any driver action normalizes to a name absent from the plan's allowlist, or if the plan lists a name the driver never writes, flag it as a correctness gap. Also verify that the existing test-design-log-publish.sh fixtures for .completed/emit_plan match the current driver behavior so the proposed regression test additions start from a correct baseline. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: output-token-consumers
archetypes.rationale: WI3 introduces a new WARN=marker-delete-failed token from design-pause-load.sh; the plan updates design-pause-load.md but does not audit shell callers that parse LOAD_OK/ERROR output — missed callers may silently ignore the new WARN or branch incorrectly, leaving the stale-marker situation invisible to the operator.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every shell or script caller of design-pause-load.sh and find any that parse its key=value output stream (LOAD_OK, ERROR, WARN tokens). Verify that each such caller either already handles or gracefully ignores a WARN token, or is explicitly listed in the plan's change set. Check whether design-pause-load.md's output-contract section is updated to document the new WARN=marker-delete-failed token as the plan claims, and confirm the plan does not accidentally leave the LOAD_OK=true + WARN=marker-delete-failed combination undocumented. If any caller that surfaces load output to the operator or that branches on WARN is missing from the plan's file list, flag the omission. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-line-accuracy
archetypes.rationale: The plan prescribes assertion inversions at specific line ranges in test-design-pause-resume.sh (line 192, ~514-521, ~781-791); if those line numbers are stale or the described assertion polarity is already inverted, the implementer will modify the wrong lines and the harness will give false confidence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read skills/design/scripts/test-design-pause-resume.sh and verify each plan claim about specific line ranges: the post-success marker assertion near line 192, the body-drift block near lines 514-521, and the unloadable-snapshot/clear-marker block near lines 781-791. For each, confirm that the assertion currently present has the polarity the plan says to invert (e.g., currently asserts marker remains where the plan says invert to assert marker absent). Also confirm that test cases for missing-restored-artifact retention and the optional marker-delete-failed stub do not already exist, to avoid the plan inadvertently directing duplicate additions. Flag any mismatch between the plan's described current state and what the file actually contains. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
